title: Tailwise Autoship Shipment Processing and Billing Standard
content:
This standard governs how a Tailwise Autoship shipment is processed, charged and recorded.

## Standard

- **Processing date.** A shipment is processed on the subscription's next ship date; a ship-now shipment is processed on the day it is requested.
- **Status at processing.** The subscription status is pending first shipment or active when the shipment is processed, as the subscription record shows it.
- **Amount billed.** The amount billed is the merchandise subtotal, less the Autoship discount, plus the standard shipping fee, the heavy-item surcharge and the packaging fee, rounded to the cent. Each charge books into the subscription's net billed total.
- **Minimum subtotal.** A shipment whose merchandise subtotal is below the program's smallest merchandise subtotal is not processed and nothing is charged; the customer is asked to raise the quantity before the next ship date, and the date is not recorded as a skip.
- **Ship-now.** A ship-now shipment requires that the program allows ship-now and that at least the program's minimum calendar days have passed since the subscription's most recent charged shipment. A ship-now shipment does not move the next ship date.
- **Pharmacy check.** Before a pharmacy shipment is charged, the linked prescription is checked. When it is not in status active, has no fill remaining, or its expiry date is not later than the processing date, the subscription moves to prescription hold and nothing is charged.
- **Fill booked.** A successful charge of a pharmacy shipment books one fill of the prescription.
- **Activation and next date.** The first charged shipment activates a subscription that is pending its first shipment, and every charged shipment sets the next ship date to the processing date plus the subscription's frequency in weeks.

## Input, judgement, outcome

| Input on the processing date | Judgement | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Status paused, payment hold, prescription hold or cancelled | Status condition not met | Not processed |
| Autoship Fresh & Frozen shipment with a merchandise subtotal of 38.99 USD | Below 39.00 USD | Not processed, nothing charged, not a skip |
| Same shipment at 39.00 USD | Not below the minimum | Processed |
| Pharmacy shipment, prescription expires on the processing date | Expiry not later than the processing date | Prescription hold, nothing charged |

## Worked bill (hypothetical)

Autoship Everyday, 2 units at 25.00 USD on the processing date: merchandise subtotal 50.00 USD; recurring discount 5 percent, 2.50 USD; standard shipping fee 0.00 (the same-day subtotal reaches 49.00 USD); no heavy units; no packaging fee. Amount billed: 50.00 less 2.50, that is 47.50 USD. With a frequency of 4 weeks and a processing date of a given Monday, the next ship date becomes the Monday four weeks later.
